\r

Because they deny the facts about human nature, their "reasoning" is diametrically opposite to common sense (blue states vs. red states).\r

The reality that people have different initiative levels, are basically selfish, and often work for their own interests before helping others, puts a libtard's [panties in a wad]. So, when citizens will not voluntarily comply with various libtard prescriptions for "the common good", then laws must be passed, or force used, to MAKE them comply. (It is the gradual path to totalitarianism).\r
\r
